description: Sex-chromosome confirmation and per-chromosome dosage check for the two cell lines
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Y-chromosome markers, DESeq2-normalized counts (locked GSE299627 matrix)
ygenes = ["RPS4Y1","DDX3Y","UTY","KDM5D","EIF1AY","USP9Y","NLGN4Y","ZFY"]
Y = pd.DataFrame([
 [16188.0,13839.0,15122.0,15627.0,15467.9,18718.7],
 [3592.7,3998.6,3959.7,3533.9,3798.4,2866.6],
 [423.8,479.9,408.4,450.5,500.8,305.7],
 [1771.0,1822.5,1810.2,1803.2,1582.2,1342.2],
 [1376.4,1279.8,1378.8,1250.5,1661.0,1684.8],
 [1261.2,1414.0,1286.6,1360.8,1181.4,764.4],
 [255.3,276.4,275.2,246.2,236.5,210.3],
 [811.6,899.8,861.6,684.5,703.9,477.0]],
 index=ygenes, columns=["WT1","WT2","WT3","DMD1","DMD2","DMD3"])

chrom = pd.DataFrame([
 ("1",1800,0.0055,0.6116),("2",1212,0.0298,0.1591),("3",983,0.0338,0.1591),("4",652,0.0361,0.1591),
 ("5",838,0.0035,0.7372),("6",906,0.0210,0.7372),("7",868,-0.0245,0.1817),("8",642,0.0792,0.0067),
 ("9",707,-0.0259,0.2884),("10",709,-0.0054,0.6116),("11",950,0.0043,0.7372),("12",986,0.0101,0.7372),
 ("13",320,-0.0367,0.6116),("14",576,-0.0261,0.6116),("15",619,-0.0434,0.0421),("16",879,-0.0157,0.1591),
 ("17",1119,-0.0303,0.1591),("18",266,-0.0660,0.3604),("19",1255,0.0272,0.2884),("20",443,0.0057,0.7372),
 ("21",190,-0.0254,0.4279),("22",430,0.0145,0.7372),("X",563,0.0522,0.1384),("Y",25,-0.1380,0.3681)],
 columns=["chrom","n","median_log2FC","q"])

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13.5, 5.0))

ax = axes[0]
x = np.arange(len(ygenes)); w = 0.13
for i, s in enumerate(Y.columns):
    ax.bar(x + (i-2.5)*w, np.log2(Y[s]+1), w,
           color="#4299e1" if i < 3 else "#dd6b20",
           label=s if i in (0,3) else None)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(ygenes, rotation=30, ha="right", fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("log2(normalized count + 1)")
ax.set_title("Both lines are male: eight Y-linked genes are expressed in all six samples\n"
             "(XIST falls below the expression filter in every sample)", fontsize=10)
ax.legend(["healthy AB1190","DMD AB1071"], fontsize=9)

ax = axes[1]
cols = ["#c53030" if q < 0.05 else "#a0aec0" for q in chrom.q]
ax.bar(range(len(chrom)), chrom.median_log2FC, color=cols, edgecolor="black", lw=0.4)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(chrom))); ax.set_xticklabels(chrom.chrom, fontsize=8)
ax.axhline(0.0061, color="black", ls=":", lw=1)
ax.text(23.4, 0.011, "genome-wide median +0.006", fontsize=8, ha="right")
ax.set_ylim(-0.18, 0.12)
ax.set_xlabel("chromosome"); ax.set_ylabel("median log2 fold change of chromosome genes")
ax.set_title("No chromosome-scale dosage difference between the lines.\n"
             "Largest shift is chr8 at +0.079 (red = BH q < 0.05); all are below 0.15.", fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print("DMD log2FC -0.431 sits at the 18.1st percentile of 563 tested chrX genes (chrX median +0.052).")
print("Among 2,381 genes of comparable abundance (baseMean 95-380), 23.9% fall by at least as much as DMD.")
